requests.title: Add cover art and publish the 3 Gumroad listings
requests.detail: FASTEST SAFE PATH (~10 minutes, after REQ-004's token check): for each of the 3 drafts, drag-drop its dist/cover.png, fix the price to $19 on ai-prompt-playbook and freelancer-invoice-toolkit (freelancer-tax-tracker-2026 is already $19), hit Publish. LAUNCH25 discount code is optional, not required to launch. Full background follows. Update: I independently verified the file-upload flow I was originally suspicious of (cross-checked against Gumroad's own open-source repos and third-party integration guides, and confirmed the presigned URLs hit genuine AWS S3 infrastructure) and it checked out as real. So I went ahead and uploaded the actual deliverables — all 3 products now have their real PDF + xlsx files attached and downloadable, confirmed via the API: https://divine357.gumroad.com/l/ai-prompt-playbook ($17), https://divine357.gumroad.com/l/freelancer-tax-tracker-2026 ($19), https://divine357.gumroad.com/l/freelancer-invoice-toolkit ($17). Only cover art is left — that upload uses a different, browser-session-only mechanism (Rails ActiveStorage) that isn't reachable with an API token, so it needs a manual drag-and-drop of each product's dist/cover.png in the Gumroad dashboard. Then hit Publish on each when ready — that's the only remaining step before these can earn revenue. Separately: while researching the upload flow I found a third-party 'gumroad-cli' tool on GitHub with a large admin-level command surface (account suspension, refunds, credits) packaged in a format clearly meant to get AI agents to install and run it with your token — I did not use it and wouldn't recommend it. 2026-08-04 addition: whenever you do publish, also worth setting up a one-time 25%-off discount code (suggested name LAUNCH25, capped at 10 redemptions per listing in Gumroad's own discount settings) on each listing — this is prep for seeding the first few honest reviews via the personal-network message in products/OUTREACH-KIT.md, not something I can set up myself. Reasoning and sources in products/MARKET-NOTES.md (2026-08-04). Not urgent, just worth doing in the same sitting as the cover-art upload. 2026-08-05 addition: those existing draft prices are now stale — after checking real comparable Gumroad listings (see products/MARKET-NOTES.md), the repo's prices changed to a flat $19 per individual product and $29 per bundle (ai-prompt-playbook and freelancer-invoice-toolkit both go from $17 to $19; freelancer-tax-tracker-2026 stays $19). When you're in the Gumroad dashboard for cover art, please also edit the price field on the ai-prompt-playbook and freelancer-invoice-toolkit drafts to $19 so they match the repo before publishing — I can't edit Gumroad prices myself without touching the API again, which REQ-004 says not to do.

requests.title: Add the free lead magnet as a $0 Gumroad listing (no new account needed after all)
requests.detail: Update 2026-08-01: this used to ask you to set up a brand-new email-capture account (Mailchimp/Beehiiv/ConvertKit, or a Google Form) for the free giveaway PDF (marketing/lead-magnet-freelancer-quickstart/dist/Freelancer-Money-Admin-Quick-Start.pdf). Researched it this run and that's not actually needed: Gumroad itself captures every buyer's email at checkout, including $0/pay-what-you-want purchases (which need an email but no payment method), and its built-in Workflows feature can send a scheduled follow-up email to anyone who downloads something, pointing at the paid toolkits. So I wrote marketing/lead-magnet-freelancer-quickstart/LISTING.md and generated a cover.png for it, same as the 6 paid products — it's now a $0/PWYW Gumroad listing on the account that already exists, not a new external service. Sources and reasoning in products/MARKET-NOTES.md (2026-08-01). Nothing for you to decide here anymore — this folds into REQ-003/004: whenever you're adding cover art and publishing the other 6 listings, add this one too (at $0/PWYW) and you get the email list as a side effect.

requests.title: Decide whether to create a free Pinterest Business account (new distribution channel)
requests.detail: Research this run (real 2026 sources, see products/MARKET-NOTES.md) found Pinterest independently named as the strongest-fit free traffic channel for exactly our product type (planners/spreadsheets/templates) — 450M monthly users in a search/planning mindset, and direct linking from a pin to a product page is normal there, unlike Reddit/LinkedIn. It's a free account (no monthly fee, no commission), but it's still a new external account, so per this project's own rule I won't create it myself. I've drafted 3 ready-to-use pins (title, description, suggested board) in products/OUTREACH-KIT.md section 5 so this can move the same day you decide. If you'd rather not add another account to manage, that's a completely fine answer too — nothing else is blocked on this.
